name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2025-11-28, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.68 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
